cards.text:
Limit 2 remote servers.
The first time each turn you install a card in the root of or protecting a remote server, you may install 1 card from HQ in the root of or protecting another remote server, ignoring all costs. You cannot score the second card this turn.
cards.title: A Teia: IP Recovery

cards.text: Threat 3 → When you rez this ice during a run against this server, you may install 1 non-agenda card from HQ or Archives in the root of or protecting another server. (This ability is active if any player has 3 or more agenda points.) [subroutine] End the run.
cards.title: Ablative Barrier

cards.text: Whenever the Runner makes a successful run on this server, play a Psi Game. (Players secretly bid 0–2[credit]. Then each player reveals and spends their bid.) If the bids differ, the Runner cannot access cards other than this upgrade for the remainder of that run. If the bids match, the Runner cannot access this upgrade for the remainder of that run. When your turn ends, you may move this upgrade to the root of another server.
cards.title: Adrian Seis

cards.text: When you install this hardware, load 3 power counters onto it. When it is empty, trash it. [interrupt] → Hosted power counter: Prevent 1 net damage. Use this ability only during a run. [interrupt] → Hosted power counter: Prevent a "when encountered" ability on a piece of ice.
cards.title: AirbladeX (JSRF Ed.)

cards.text: Threat 3 → [click], 1[credit], reveal and trash this upgrade from HQ: Do 1 meat damage. (This ability is active if any player has 3 or more agenda points.) When the Runner accesses this upgrade while it is rezzed, you may pay 2[credit] to do 2 meat damage.
cards.title: Angelique Garza Correa

cards.text: Once per turn → 0[credit]: Install 1 program from your grip (paying its install cost). Use this ability only during a run. When that run ends, trash that program if it is not a trojan.
cards.title: Arissana Rocha Nahu: Street Artist

cards.text: Gain 3[credit]. Gain 1[credit] for each card type among faceup cards in Archives. If any of those cards are agendas, gain another 2[credit].
cards.title: Armed Asset Protection

cards.text: Threat 3 → The Runner cannot spend credits while subroutines on this ice are resolving. (This ability is active if any player has 3 or more agenda points.) [subroutine] Do 1 net damage unless the Runner pays 2[credit]. [subroutine] Do 1 net damage unless the Runner pays 2[credit]. [subroutine] Do 1 net damage unless the Runner pays 2[credit].
cards.title: Attini

cards.text: Whenever you trash a card you are accessing, place 1 virus counter on this program. Interface → Hosted virus counter: Break up to 2 subroutines. Trash 1 card from your grip: +3 strength.
cards.title: Audrey v2

cards.text: Remove 1 tag: End the run. Use this ability only during a run against another server.
cards.title: B-1001

cards.text:
Run any server. If successful, resolve 2 of the following in any order:
  • Draw 2 cards.
  • Install 1 card from your grip, paying 1[credit] less.
  • Remove 1 tag.
  • Place 4[credit] on this event. You can spend hosted credits to pay trash costs for the remainder of this run.
cards.title: Bahia Bands

cards.text: When your turn begins, you may choose a card type to look at the top card of R&D. If that card has the chosen type, you may reveal it and gain 2[credit].
cards.title: Balanced Coverage

cards.text: Interface → 2[credit]: Subroutines on the barrier you are encountering cannot end the run for the remainder of this encounter.
cards.title: Banner

cards.text: [click][click]: Run HQ. If successful, instead of breaching HQ, breach R&D. When you do, access 1 additional card.
cards.title: Beatriz Friere Gonzalez

cards.text:
While the Runner is accessing this asset in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this asset anywhere except in Archives, you may pay 4[credit] to give them 2 tags.
cards.title: Behold!

cards.text: Whenever you bypass a piece of ice, you may remove this hardware from the game to derez that ice.
cards.title: Capybara

cards.text: The Corp may reveal an agenda from HQ. If they do, gain [click] and draw 1 card. Otherwise, look at the top 3 cards of R&D.
cards.title: Chrysopoeian Skimming

cards.text: Whenever you encounter a barrier, you may spend 3 hosted power counters to bypass it. Whenever this program fully breaks a piece of ice, place 1 power counter on this program. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 barrier subroutine. 1[credit]: +1 strength.
cards.title: Curupira

cards.text: Whenever you rez a piece of ice, place 2[credit] on this asset. You can spend hosted credits to pay install costs. [trash]: Take all credits from this asset.
cards.title: Cybersand Harvester

cards.text:
As an additional cost to trash this upgrade, the Runner must add 2 cards from the grip at random to the bottom of the stack.
Persistent → As an additional cost to steal an agenda from this server or its root, the Runner must add 2 cards from the grip at random to the bottom of the stack.
cards.title: Daniela Jorge Inácio

cards.text: Threat 4 → When you install this resource, place 2[credit] on it. (This ability is active if any player has 4 or more agenda points.) Whenever you play a run event, place 1[credit] on this resource. [click]: Run any server. You can spend hosted credits during that run.
cards.title: Debbie "Downtown" Moreira

cards.text: The first time each turn the Runner steals or trashes a Corp card, place 1 power counter on this identity. [click], hosted power counter: Look at the top 3 cards of R&D. You may install 1 of those cards.
cards.title: Epiphany Analytica: Nations Undivided

cards.text: Once per turn → [click], take 1 tag: Run Archives. If successful, instead of breaching Archives, breach R&D. Threat 3 → Whenever you breach R&D during a run on Archives, access 1 additional card. (This ability is active if any player has 3 or more agenda points.)
cards.title: Eru Ayase-Pessoa

cards.text: When your turn begins, you may look at the top 3 cards of R&D and arrange them in any order. Then, if this server is not protected by ice, you may draw 1 card.
cards.title: Federal Fundraising

cards.text:
Rez only during your turn.
The first run each turn cannot be made against a remote server.
The first time each turn a run on Archives begins, if this server is not protected by ice, do 2 net damage.
cards.title: Front Company

cards.text: When this agenda is scored or stolen, do 2 net damage.
cards.title: Fujii Asset Retrieval

cards.text: Gain 5[credit]. You may install 1 card from HQ. You may remove 1 tag to place 1 advancement counter on that card.
cards.title: Greasing the Palm

cards.text: Once per turn → [click]: Gain [click]. Run a remote server. When that run ends, if it was unsuccessful, take 1 tag. [click], [trash]: Gain [click][click]. Remove 1 tag.
cards.title: Hannah "Wheels" Pilintra

cards.text: +1[mu] Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen, add 1 unrezzed card to HQ. Limit 1 console per player.
cards.title: Hermes

cards.text: Threat 4 → When the Runner encounters this ice, give them 1 tag unless they spend [click]. (This ability is active if any player has 4 or more agenda points.) [subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag. [subroutine] If the Runner is tagged, do 1 core damage.
cards.title: Jaguarundi

cards.text: Run R&D. If successful, draw 5 cards.
cards.title: Joy Ride

cards.text: The first time each turn the Corp installs a card in the root of a server, you may trash the top card of your stack to draw 1 card.
cards.title: Lago Paranoá Shelter

cards.text: Whenever you encounter a piece of AP, destroyer, or observer ice, you may trash this program to bypass that ice.
cards.title: Laser Pointer

cards.text: +2[mu] The first time each turn you install a program, you may draw 1 card. Limit 1 console per player.
cards.title: LilyPAD

cards.text: Install only on a piece of ice. Threat 4 → When you install this program, it gets +3 strength for the remainder of the turn. (This ability is active if any player has 4 or more agenda points.) Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 subroutine on a sentry protecting this server. 1[credit]: +2 strength.
cards.title: Living Mural

cards.text: [trash]: End the run unless the Runner spends [click]. Use this ability only during a run on this server. [subroutine] The Runner loses [click]. [subroutine] The Runner loses [click]. [subroutine] End the run.
cards.title: M.I.C.

cards.text: Once per turn → When you breach HQ or R&D during a run, if you did not break any subroutines during that run, you may access 1 additional card.
cards.title: Mercury: Chrome Libertador

cards.text:
Resolve 1 of the following:
  • Gain 4[credit] and draw 2 cards. Add 1 card from HQ to the top of R&D.
  • Do X net damage. X is equal to the number of tags the Runner has, up to 3.
cards.title: Mindscaping

cards.text:
Install only on a piece of ice.
Host ice gets −2 strength. Each other piece of ice protecting this server gets −1 strength.
cards.title: Monkeywrench

cards.text: Play only if the Runner stole or trashed a Corp card during their last turn. After you resolve this operation, your action phase ends. Give the Runner 2 tags. Threat 3 → You may pay 5[credit] to give the Runner 2 tags. (This ability is active if any player has 3 or more agenda points.)
cards.title: Oppo Research

cards.text: When the Runner steals this agenda, give them 1 tag. [click], remove 1 tag: Shuffle this agenda into R&D. The Corp can use this ability only if this agenda is in the Runner's score area.
cards.title: Oracle Thinktank

cards.text:
When the Runner passes this ice, if there are 4 or more cards in the grip, give them 1 tag.
[subroutine] Do 1 net damage.
[subroutine] Do 1 net damage.
cards.title: Phoneutria

cards.text:
Install only on a piece of ice.
Whenever you pass host ice, you may gain [click]. If this is not the first time you gained [click] during a run this turn, add this program to your grip.
cards.title: Pichação

cards.text: As an additional cost to play this operation, spend [click]. Search R&D for 1 operation or agenda and reveal it. (Shuffle R&D after searching it.) Add that card to HQ. Threat 3 → You may play or install 1 card from HQ. (This ability is active if any player has 3 or more agenda points.)
cards.title: Pivot

cards.text: Run a central server. The first time you encounter a piece of ice during that run, bypass it. Threat 4 → The second time you encounter a piece of ice during that run, you may spend [click] to bypass it. (This ability is active if any player has 4 or more agenda points.)
cards.title: S-Dobrado

cards.text:
Install only on a piece of ice.
Whenever host ice is rezzed or derezzed, gain 3[credit].
cards.title: Saci

cards.text: Whenever you score an agenda (including this one), you may do 1 core damage.
cards.title: Salvo Testing

cards.text: Threat 4 → This program gets −2 strength. (This ability is active if any player has 4 or more agenda points.) Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 code gate subroutine. 2[credit]: +2 strength.
cards.title: Shibboleth

cards.text: Install only on a piece of ice. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 subroutine on host ice. Use this ability only once per encounter.
cards.title: Slap Vandal

cards.text: [click], 1[credit], reveal and trash this agenda from HQ: Place 2 advancement counters on 1 installed card that you can advance.
cards.title: Slash and Burn Agriculture

cards.text:
The first time each turn you trash a Corp card, place 1 power counter on this hardware.
When your turn begins, you may remove 1 hosted power counter to draw 1 card or remove 1 tag.
cards.title: Solidarity Badge

cards.text:
Threat 4 → When the Runner encounters this ice, it gains X "[subroutine] End the run." subroutines for the remainder of this run, after its other subroutines. X is equal to the number of tags the Runner has.
[subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag.
[subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag.
cards.title: Starlit Knight

cards.text: Each run, as long as a piece of ice has been derezzed during that run, each installed icebreaker gets –2 strength. Once per turn → When a run begins, you may derez 1 piece of ice not protecting the attacked server to gain 1[credit].
cards.title: Stegodon MK IV

cards.text:
Gain 4[credit].
When this event is trashed from your grip or stack, you may gain 2[credit].
cards.title: Strike Fund

cards.text: When the Runner passes this ice, you may swap it with a piece of ice from HQ. If you do, gain 4[credit]. (The new ice is installed unrezzed. You do not pay an install cost.) [subroutine] End the run.
cards.title: Tatu-Bola

cards.text: Trash the top 4 cards of your stack. You may install 1 of those cards, paying 3[credit] less.
cards.title: The Price

cards.text: [click], 1[credit], reveal and trash this ice from HQ: Place 3 advancement counters on 1 installed piece of ice. You can advance this ice. It gets +1 strength for each hosted advancement counter. [subroutine] Gain 1[credit]. End the run.
cards.title: Tree Line

cards.text: Remote server only. Persistent → Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen from the root of this server, you may search R&D for 1 piece of ice. (Shuffle R&D after searching it.) Install and rez that ice, paying a total of 3[credit] less.
cards.title: Tucana

cards.text: This program can only interface with ice hosting a trojan program. Interface → 2[credit]: Break up to 3 code gate subroutines. If at least 1 subroutine was broken this way, each player may draw 1 card.
cards.title: Umbrella

cards.text: When your turn begins, you may add 1 installed non-virus trojan program to your grip. If you do, place 2[credit] on this resource. You can spend hosted credits to install cards.
cards.title: Urban Art Vernissage

cards.text:
As an additional cost to rez this ice, take 1 bad publicity or remove 1 tag.
[subroutine] Gain 2[credit].
[subroutine] The Runner loses 2[credit].
[subroutine] End the run if you have more credits than the Runner.
cards.title: Valentão

cards.text: Whenever the Runner passes this ice after encountering it, if they did not break its printed subroutine with a decoder during that encounter, give them 1 tag. [subroutine] The Runner loses 1[credit].
cards.title: Virtual Service Agent

cards.text: The rez cost of each piece of ice protecting this server is lowered by 2[credit]. Threat 4 → The rez cost of each card in the root of this server is lowered by 2[credit]. (This ability is active if any player has 4 or more agenda points.) When your turn ends, you may move this upgrade to the root of another server.
cards.title: Vovô Ozetti

cards.text: Whenever you finish taking an action, if you have taken that action exactly 3 times this turn, gain [click].
cards.title: Wage Workers

cards.text: Gain 1[credit] for each card in HQ.
cards.title: Your Digital Life

printings.flavor: "If you want to put your money where your mouth is, there are some picketers who could use your support."

"You ask how we can even try to stop them? A simple answer: not alone."
—Sebastião Souza Pessoa
It is hard, once free, to learn when to call for help.

"What do you want from me, blood?"
—S3ym0ur
Above the maze of smoke and swinging fists, they saw the banner waving.
Random sabotage accomplishes little; better to strike their weakest points again and again.
Luciana loved it when mamãe and papai finished work early, so they could all go home together.
"How far shall we go this time?"

"Animals, tea, meetings, dead drops. Paranoá has you covered, so we keep them covered."
—Sebastião Souza Pessoa
I decided; I am free.
Even the tiniest scrap of data can become the key to riches.

"One day I looked into the mirror and saw not my own reflection, but a new friend eager to help me."
—Mercury
This world is not beautiful, and yet that is why it is.
Take only what you need.
Dazzle. Disorient. Disappear.

I am life, I am sun,
Iʼm a trap, Iʼm a gun,
Iʼm the wind in the dust,
Iʼm the devil that you trust.

"Corporate security regards me as merely another Nico, and that shall ever be their mistake."
—Mercury
Art knows no borders.
Designed by 2020 American Continental Champion Jason Ford
Leaps and bounds better than the competition!

"From up here, I can see everything. And from down there, everyone can see this."
—Víbora

"I consider it an improvement."
—Arissana Rocha Nahu

"However bad it gets out there, know that weʼll still have each other."
—Tom "Spider" Milhas
"And who can tell me what sort of practical applications this has?"
"...and here, we can see an excellent example of meta neo-Gemeosianism."
"Yes, that explosion was quite loud. May I pour you another drink?"
Exceeding expectations for armor superiority.
"Free" as in markets, "cheap" as in beer.

"Hey Br3n-N, just doing the hourly check-in. I saw a weird cyber-echo near your last node. You OK, mate?"
—Moth
We make these arms for all, so that none who oppose peace would risk their own destruction.
"Haas-Bioroid deeply appreciates your assistance in locating our... employee."
Caveant Fugitivi.
Deep down, she knew Benício wasnʼt coming back.
"Do you take walk-ins?"
The construct turns to you, eyes wild. "Beloved," it asks, "is that you?"
Next! Designed by 2020 Intercontinental Champion Yannick Stucki

"When you stretch a mind it expands, sometimes until it snaps."
—Adrian Seis
"They call me turncoat. I call them broke."
Results, Delivered.

"You really thought weʼd let you keep this data?"
—The Holo Man
"A lively but peaceful crowd of concerned counter-protesters have come out to—damn it, cut! Can we get the sledgehammer out of the frame?"
Be afraid.
Raising money is useful, but discovering which politician is in need of it is vastly more important.
An exemplar of Starlightʼs hubris, it stands vigil over secrets of hypocrisy.

"No one has ever told me to get lost so politely."
—Arissana Rocha Nahu
Merely a fun little personality test.
Acres of rainforest live or die by quarterly revenue projections.
Nothingʼs as precious as a hole in the ground.
The forest around them grew denser with each beat of their heart.

"The only rule you need to remember is that it makes the rules."
—Pumpkin-and-Dumplin

"Nuvem pays us to guard this land, and thatʼs all there is to it."
—Angelique Garza Correa
"Shoot!"
Their mouths are ever open, blaring sirens never to cease.
"Humans crafted me as a lie, but my patron helped me find the truth. This is my gift."
